dog.description_text:
Etta was left behind in a crate during a Mississippi ice storm; freezing, terrified, and completely alone. When she was found, she was shivering and scared, but safe at last.

Despite everything, Etta’s heart is still so very sweet. Once she knows she’s safe, she leans in for love and comfort, soaking up every bit of warmth she can find.

After surviving the coldest night, Etta is ready for a lifetime of warmth; soft bed, steady love, and a family who will never leave her behind again

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
